programs.evidence: Georgetown is a highly selective university, and its English department says many majors double major in fields like government, history or STEM and go on to competitive jobs and graduate schools.
Yale is one of the most selective universities in the country, and its English major stresses research, argument and writing, which places graduates with top employers.
Colgate is a highly selective liberal arts university that admits only a small share of its applicants, and its graduates tend to go to strong employers.
Canisius offers a standard English BA for traditional undergraduates, with transfer pathways from community colleges, and I found nothing in its admission or format that explains the low earnings.

Tennessee Tech offers a standard English BA with literature, creative writing, rhetoric and technical communication concentrations, and I found no admission or format feature that explains the low earnings.
The earnings figure rests on fewer than twenty graduates, too few to be a reliable measure of the program.
